ev_ink_forge.name: The Ink Forge
ev_ink_forge.desc: Trade 40 journey XP for 250 golden ink. Use it on the golden bridge ahead.

ev_shrine.name: The Quiet Shrine
ev_shrine.desc: Receive a random blessing. Start the next battle at 80% HP.

ev_mercenary.name: Wandering Mercenaries
ev_mercenary.desc: Pay 60 coins to add 2 soldiers to the selected slot for this journey.

ev_mystery_chest.name: The Mystery Chest
ev_mystery_chest.desc: 60%: choose a blessing. 40%: an extra goblin squad joins your next battle.
